(ns prototype.consumer-slot-probe-v1
  "Host-only direct register-sizing probe after the completed frontend benchmark.
   Changes only the existing slot cache via its public API; no guest invocation."
  (:require [prototype.slot-count :as slots]
            [prototype.resident-frontend :as resident]
            [clojure.data.json :as json]))
(defonce claimed (atom false))
(defn timed [functions]
  (let [start (System/nanoTime) width (slots/program-slots functions)]
    {:ms (/ (- (System/nanoTime) start) 1000000.0) :slots width}))
(defn run! []
  (when-not (compare-and-set! claimed false true)
    (throw (ex-info "Direct slot probe already claimed" {})))
  (let [warm (prototype.globals-consumer-warm-profile-v1/summary)
        actual (prototype.resident-import-acceptance-oct21/checkpoint)
        a (resident/snapshot (:input-context actual))
        b (resident/snapshot (get-in actual [:loaded-B :context]))
        fa (:functions (:world a)) fb (:functions (:world b))]
    (when-not (and (= :passed (:phase warm)) (= :passed (:phase actual))
                   (not (identical? fa fb)))
      (throw (ex-info "Completed warm benchmark and distinct actual programs required" {})))
    (let [samples (mapv (fn [i]
                          (let [a-time (timed fa) b-time (timed fb) repeat-time (timed fb)]
                            {:kind (if (< i 2) :warmup :measured)
                             :A a-time :B-after-A b-time :B-repeat repeat-time}))
                        (range 7))
          unchanged (and (identical? a (resident/snapshot (:input-context actual)))
                         (identical? b (resident/snapshot (get-in actual [:loaded-B :context]))))]
      (when-not unchanged (throw (ex-info "Borrowed slot probe contexts changed" {})))
      {:scope "direct-global-program-slot-cache/1" :phase :passed
       :guest-invocations 0 :contexts-created 0 :borrowed-contexts-unchanged unchanged
       :function-count-A (count fa) :function-count-B (count fb)
       :warmup-iterations 2 :measured-iterations 5 :samples samples
       :limits "Direct host sizing only; not a call-time attribution or native comparison."})))
